result.summary: Found several visual issues: a broken promo badge showing '-100%', truncated restaurant names, and a cut-off category chip row indicator.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card displays a green badge reading '-100%', which looks like a broken or incorrectly calculated discount rather than a meaningful offer.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount logic and display a sensible value (e.g. '-20%' or '50% off'); hide the badge if the discount is invalid or 100%.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word in the Fastest near you row, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure adequate card width/ellipsis handling so names remain legible.

issues.description: A faint partial circle of the next category chip is visible on the far right of the filter row, which can look like a rendering glitch rather than intentional scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding/mask to the chip scroller or ensure the peek of the next chip is intentional and evenly styled.
